name: qlrisk_price_swaption
title: Price a Swaption
description:
Price one Swaption - option to enter into a swap (qlrisk Swaption).
Inputs (* required, name=default): notional=1000000, expiry*, swap_start*, swap_end*, strike_pct*, swaption_type=payer (payer/receiver), exercise_style=european (european/american/bermudan), floating_index=SOFR, volatility_pct, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: position.
Example: {"notional": 1000000, "expiry": "1Y", "swap_start": "1Y", "swap_end": "6Y", "strike_pct": 4} gives NPV 20,450.09 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
